messages.subject: heatmap/correlation matrix
parts:
Dear ggplot user I'm looking for an easy way in ggplot to reproduce a similar figure. 
My data is arranged in long format, where first and second column correspond to the x and y axis, 
the third column is the probability of the relationship observed between x and y 
and the fourth column is the categorical variable to separate the upper and lower matrix.

thanks!
Thierry

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: heatmap/correlation matrix
parts:
Hi:

In the absence of a reproducible example:

(1) Use geom_polygon() to produce the two triangles;
(2) Use annotate() to put in the text at the corners;
(3) Assuming you have a factor to distinguish full and half sibs, map
color and fill to that factor.
(4) Use scale_colour_manual() and scale_fill_manual() to control the
(fill) colors you want.
(5) To suppress the legends, use guides = "none" inside each
scale_*_manual() call.

Dennis
